reviews.title: Garbage Service
reviews.text: I've been a customer with Dashlane for several years. My email was impacted in a breach with AT&T, so in mid-2024 I created a new account and transferred my data over. Since then, I've used their service with no problem until 2 days ago. When my service renewed (which it did just fine in 2025) I was suddenly locked out of my account. The screen said my subscription had expired and I needed to pay. When I tried to pay, it said I'd already paid. Which was true because I pay through Apple, was going to pay a second time just to get access to my data. Couldn't get in, clicked around FOREVER to find their support bot. Bot couldn't help me but refused to pass me to support because I wasn't a "paying member" - I literally was and said that multiple times. When I finally did get to support, they told me a bunch of nonsense, implying the issue was on my end, which was absolutely incorrect. "It was because my real account was the old email," "Apple collected the funds for the wrong account," blah blah blah. I submitted proof that that was not the case. Agent didn't even bother to look at it. Asked for a supervisor. Never got to one. I eventually just got a refund from Apple and after MANY attempts successfully exported my passwords from the account. I was experiencing multiple issues including being logged out over and over again - that was never addressed. I won't be using their service going forward. Their support team doesn't read messages, they do not care that they're handling inc

reviews.title: SWITCHED TO KEEPER!
reviews.text:
I don’t usually write reviews but I had to for this as it’s important who you put trust when it comes to accessing the whole digital world. After being a loyal customer for over 5 years. My renewal was not working after paying £33. Tried to renew again with the increased prices now starting at £60 and still nothing. Now I have to wait up to 30 days to get £90 back and couldn’t access any of my passwords! 

The support team’s best solution was to create another account under a new email? How’s that my problem and you are asking me to make a new email address just for this…what am I paying £60 a year for. Anyways switching to keeper was simple and imported my passwords within seconds and they have better features and security for only £40. 

I’d rather use a company that values my loyalty and actually solves the problem rather than treating me like a number. Anyways go to Keeper instead people because if they don’t value loyal customers it means they just want to support you into subscribing! Keeper’s auto-fill is much faster too with Face ID popping up straight away on the login page to quickly auto-fill. Dashlane’s auto-fill integration is stuck in the past.
